meta.title: Feature: Reporting — Revenue, VAT & CSV Export

content.summary: Reporting module delivering daily and monthly revenue + VAT summaries, and a CSV export of invoices for Vietnamese tax authority submission. Backend in Sprint 5, frontend in Sprint 6.
content.legal_context: Vietnamese businesses must submit hóa đơn điện tử data to the tax authority. CSV export is an interim format for manual submission while the direct API integration is deferred.

user_stories.want: to view daily revenue and VAT breakdown for any date
user_stories.so_that: I can reconcile the day's sales with our cash register

user_stories.want: to view monthly aggregate revenue and VAT
user_stories.so_that: I can prepare monthly tax declarations

user_stories.want: to export invoices for a date range as CSV
user_stories.so_that: I can submit them to the Vietnamese tax authority

user_stories.want: to see a dashboard chart of revenue for last 7 days
user_stories.so_that: I have at-a-glance visibility of store performance

business_rules: BR-RPT-01: All monetary values in VNĐ integer — no rounding with fractions
BR-RPT-02: Date filters use store local time (UTC+7)
BR-RPT-03: /reports/* accessible to accountant + store-manager + admin
BR-RPT-04: CSV must include invoiceNumber, issueDate, buyerName, totalVnd, taxVnd columns minimum

audit.author: vibe-project-manager
audit.note: reporting feature created. Backend Sprint 5, frontend Sprint 6. Legal reporting requirement.
